## Types

### `DropzoneFile`

| Prop | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `name` | `string` | yes |  |
| `kind` | `string` |  | Short type tag shown in the row chip, e.g. "pdf". |
| `size` | `string` |  |  |
| `progress` | `number` |  | 0–100. Omit for a finished upload. |
| `error` | `string` |  |  |
| `removeHref` | `string` |  | POST endpoint that removes the upload and answers with the re-rendered `Dropzone` (it is swapped `outer` into `#<id>`). Rendered as a real form, never a GET link — removal is a state change. |

### `DropzoneProps`

| Prop | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `id` | `string` | yes |  |
| `name` | `string` | yes |  |
| `accept` | `string` |  |  |
| `multiple` | `boolean` |  |  |
| `label` | `Html | string` |  |  |
| `hint` | `string` |  |  |
| `files` | `DropzoneFile[]` |  | Server-rendered upload records. A file input is never echoed back into re-rendered markup (keptValues() strips it), so this list must come from your own store, not the submitted form values. |

## Behaviour

`components/dropzone/dropzone.js` ships in `ui.js` (delegated on `document`, re-initialised after a rAPId swap).

Attributes it reads or writes: `data-dropzone-remove`.
